short_description: Follow an FFmpeg export by its real progress and estimate the seconds left.
description: Follow an FFmpeg export by its real progress and estimate the seconds left. Start FFmpeg with -progress /path/to/render.progress and your normal input and output options. Set file to that progress path and duration_seconds to the target timeline length. The decoder uses the last complete progress block and handles unavailable speed and the terminal end marker.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
